title: The Sodium Gaslamp Color Contradiction
description:
📻 Decoded Radio Transmission:
Witness C: 'Under the monochromatic yellow sodium gaslamp, I clearly distinguished the killer's bright red ribbon from a green ribbon.'
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Monochromatic sodium light renders red and green as identical dark gray.
solution: Color discrimination under monochromatic light is impossible. Witness C lied.
